WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.target_id)
      r.target_id,
      r.run_id,
      r.finished_at,
      coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_collection_run r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
    AND r.status IN ('completed', 'partial')
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY r.target_id, r.finished_at DESC
),
current_design AS (
  SELECT g.target_id
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = g.target_id AND lr.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT target_id) AS databases_with_design_issues
FROM current_design;

SELECT
  date_trunc('${bucket:raw}', g.collected_at) AS time,
  coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS metric,
  count(DISTINCT g.target_id) AS databases_with_design_issues
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)

panels.description: Latest snapshot in selected time range. Sorted by number of DATA_MODEL_ISSUES findings.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.target_id)
      r.target_id,
      r.run_id,
      r.finished_at,
      coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_collection_run r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
    AND r.status IN ('completed', 'partial')
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY r.target_id, r.finished_at DESC
),
current_design AS (
  SELECT
    lr.environment,
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint,
    g.priority,
    g.risk_level,
    g.object_type,
    g.schema_name,
    g.table_name,
    g.column_name,
    g.title,
    g.recommendation_note,
    g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = g.target_id AND lr.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
)
SELECT
  environment,
  target_id,
  count(*) AS design_findings,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') AS high_priority,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high_risk,
  count(DISTINCT object_type) AS object_types,
  max(collected_at) AS last_collected_at
FROM current_design
GROUP BY environment, target_id
ORDER BY design_findings DESC, high_priority DESC, high_risk DESC, target_id
LIMIT 100;

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.target_id)
      r.target_id,
      r.run_id,
      r.finished_at,
      coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_collection_run r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
    AND r.status IN ('completed', 'partial')
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY r.target_id, r.finished_at DESC
)
SELECT
  lr.environment,
  g.target_id,
  g.rank_position,
  g.priority,
  g.risk_level,
  g.object_type,
  g.schema_name,
  g.table_name,
  g.column_name,
  g.title,
  g.recommendation_note,
  g.fix_strategy,
  g.improvement_sql
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = g.target_id AND lr.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
ORDER BY
  CASE g.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  CASE g.risk_level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  g.rank_position DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

panels.description: A correction is inferred when a DATA_MODEL_ISSUES finding was seen in the selected time range but is no longer present in the latest snapshot for the same database.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.target_id)
      r.target_id,
      r.run_id,
      r.finished_at,
      coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_collection_run r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
    AND r.status IN ('completed', 'partial')
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY r.target_id, r.finished_at DESC
),
seen_design AS (
  SELECT
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint,
    min(g.collected_at) AS first_seen,
    max(g.collected_at) AS last_seen,
    max(g.title) AS title,
    max(g.recommendation_note) AS recommendation_note
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY g.target_id, g.finding_fingerprint
),
current_design AS (
  SELECT
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = g.target_id AND lr.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
),
corrected_design AS (
  SELECT sd.*
  FROM seen_design sd
  JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = sd.target_id
  LEFT JOIN current_design cd
    ON cd.target_id = sd.target_id
   AND cd.finding_fingerprint = sd.finding_fingerprint
  WHERE cd.finding_fingerprint IS NULL
    AND sd.last_seen < lr.finished_at
)
SELECT
  lr.environment,
  cd.target_id,
  count(*) AS corrected_design_findings,
  min(cd.first_seen) AS first_seen,
  max(cd.last_seen) AS last_seen_before_latest_snapshot,
  max(lr.finished_at) AS latest_snapshot_at
FROM corrected_design cd
JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = cd.target_id
GROUP BY lr.environment, cd.target_id
ORDER BY corrected_design_findings DESC, last_seen_before_latest_snapshot DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH latest_run AS (

),
seen_design AS (
  SELECT
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint,
    min(g.collected_at) AS first_seen,
    max(g.collected_at) AS last_seen,
    max(g.priority) AS priority,
    max(g.risk_level) AS risk_level,
    max(g.object_type) AS object_type,
    max(g.schema_name) AS schema_name,
    max(g.table_name) AS table_name,
    max(g.column_name) AS column_name,
    max(g.title) AS title,
    max(g.recommendation_note) AS recommendation_note
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY g.target_id, g.finding_fingerprint
),
current_design AS (
  SELECT
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = g.target_id AND lr.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE g.advisor_group = 'DATA_MODEL_ISSUES'
)
SELECT
  lr.environment,
  sd.target_id,
  sd.priority,
  sd.risk_level,
  sd.object_type,
  sd.schema_name,
  sd.table_name,
  sd.column_name,
  sd.title,
  sd.recommendation_note,
  sd.first_seen,
  sd.last_seen AS last_seen_before_latest_snapshot,
  lr.finished_at AS latest_snapshot_at
FROM seen_design sd
JOIN latest_run lr ON lr.target_id = sd.target_id
LEFT JOIN current_design cd
  ON cd.target_id = sd.target_id
 AND cd.finding_fingerprint = sd.finding_fingerprint
WHERE cd.finding_fingerprint IS NULL
  AND sd.last_seen < lr.finished_at
ORDER BY sd.last_seen DESC, sd.target_id
